slo_context.purpose: To ensure the reliability and timeliness of financial data for accurate reporting.

data_freshness_slo.reasoning: To ensure data is up-to-date for the morning dashboard.
data_freshness_slo.breach_impact: Stale data leads to incorrect financial reports.

quality_threshold_slo.reasoning: To maintain high data quality for accurate analytics.
quality_threshold_slo.breach_impact: Low-quality data results in erroneous financial insights.

row_count_slo.reasoning: To account for variability in daily transaction volumes.

pipeline_runtime_slo.reasoning: To ensure the pipeline completes before the morning dashboard update.
pipeline_runtime_slo.breach_impact: Delayed pipeline runtime causes late data availability.
